about: Vince McMahon Reaction is a three-row template with blank white panels on the left and three frames of the longtime WWE chairman on the right, his face shifting from wide-eyed interest, to a delighted open grin, to a full head-back, jaw-dropped gasp of ecstasy. Each step up the ladder makes him look more overwhelmed, so the format is all about escalation: three options, each one better than the last, ending in something that pushes him over the edge. It is used for upgrades, ranking things from good to unbelievable, and for joking that a clearly absurd or ridiculous option is the most exciting of all.
usage:
There are three text boxes in the white panels on the left, top to bottom, each matched to the reaction beside it. Box one is the decent option, box two is the better one, box three is the absurd, over-the-top version that earns the full gasp.

Keep the climb steady and make the last step a real surprise, either wildly excessive or cleverly lazy. It suits product tiers, food upgrades, gaming loadouts, shipping speeds and excuses. Short lines read best because each panel is narrow.
